own_solution.law: Infinite-well eigenfunction psi_n = sqrt(2/L) sin(n pi x/L); P = integral_a^b |psi_2|^2 dx = (b-a)/L - [sin(4 pi b/L) - sin(4 pi a/L)]/(4 pi)
assumptions: probe responds with unit efficiency inside the slice and not outside
single Born-rule measurement on the stationary state

notes: Base: a = 0.6, b = 1.5, L = 3 nm: (b-a)/L = 0.3; sin(4 pi b/L) = sin(2 pi) = 0; sin(4 pi a/L) = sin(0.8 pi) = 0.587785; P = 0.3 + 0.587785/(4 pi) = 0.3 + 0.046775 = 0.34678. With b = 1.74 nm: (b-a)/L = 0.38; sin(2.32 pi) = sin(57.6 deg) = 0.844328; P = 0.38 - (0.844328 - 0.587785)/12.566371 = 0.38 - 0.020415 = 0.35959. Earlier-measurement and second-probe sentences have no path to this measurement (D). The numbered variants all state 0.24 nm; T0018 and TE382 are numeral-free variants.
